messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] routing_error · capacity-tier spillover detected for us-west-2 at 2093456789
incident-bot: affected_tenants=5, symptom=hosted->dedicated misroute, 5xx spike +14%, latency +120ms, auto-created incident thread

Sara (SRE): seeing a burst of 502/504s from hosted customers. Grafana shows requests landing on dedicated pools that should be isolating tenants.

Alex K: @Devon can you take oncall? looks like potential tenant isolation issue.

pagerduty: Paging Devon (oncall) — incident assigned.

Devon (oncall): oncall here. pulling policy configs now. can someone drop the policy get output pls?

Mike C: `redwoodctl routing-policy get spillover --env prod --region us-west-2`

Mike C: ```json
{"name":"spillover","rules":[{"match":{"tier":"hosted"},"action":{"route_to":"dedicated-variant-v2","weight":100}}],"version":7382}```

Devon (oncall): ugh. that rule looks wrong. dedicated-variant-v2 is the new A/B variant that only has dedicated-compatible tenants. it should have had a tenant-tag filter. no constraints -> broad spillover. looks like a rollout script omitted the tenant selector.

Sara (SRE): that matches traces — hosted tenant requests are falling back to dedicated variant because of fallback-policy scan.

Alex K: @Devon any quick mitigation? we need to stop cross-tenant routing.

Devon (oncall): temp mitigation: set rule weight to 0 and revert to prefer-hosted. running: `redwoodctl routing-policy update spillover --set rules[0].action.weight=0 --dry-run=false`

Devon (oncall): applying now...

Devon (oncall): ✅ applied. new policy commit 7383. throwing a validation guard to block empty tenant selectors next.

Mike C: monitoring: errors dropping. 5xx rate back down to baseline in the last 2 minutes. latency trending back to normal.

Sara (SRE): customer impact: acme-corp (hosted-tier) and two smaller hosted customers showed elevated latency and failed requests for ~8 minutes. frontend retries handled most, but some 502s leaked to user sessions.

Alex K: rolling forward with an explicit scoped rule. Devon, can you push a scoped rule that only allows dedicated-variant-v2 for tenants with tag `dedicated_eligible:true`?

Devon (oncall): creating scoped rule: ```yaml
- match:
    tier: hosted
  match_extra:
    tenant_tags:
      dedicated_eligible: true
  action:
    route_to: dedicated-variant-v2
    weight: 100
```

Devon (oncall): applied as commit 7384. validating.

Mike C: Can we add a quick guard in the config-service to reject rules that route hosted->dedicated without tenant_tags? would have prevented this.

Sara (SRE): agreed. follow-up item. also add a dashboard alert for sudden cross-pool routing volume deltas.

Alex K: severity: declared SEV2 due to customer-facing errors and potential isolation break. notifying support and CSMs.

pagerduty: Devon acknowledged. oncall escalation unchanged.

Devon (oncall): post-mitigation checks: 1) policy rollback done 2) scoped rule applied 3) traffic normalized 4) no further 5xx spikes in 15m window.

Sara (SRE): tagging incidents channel for postmortem. linking traces and sample request ids for acme-corp.

Alex K: assigning postmortem to Alex K. owner: Alex K. Scribe: Mike C. timeline and RCA due EOD tomorrow. action items: a) config-service validation b) rollout script safeguard c) add unit test for policy parser d) dashboard alert for cross-pool delta.

Devon (oncall): adding temporary runbook note: if spillover shows unexpected wide match -> `redwoodctl routing-policy update --set rules[0].action.weight=0` and page infra to rollback.

Mike C: customers notified by support. CSMs flagged acme-corp; they saw a 15 second window of partial failures, followed by retries.

Sara (SRE): closing out active mitigation. leaving thread open for postmortem updates. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. incident_id=INC-2093456789

Alex K: marking last_message_ts at 2093457111. will update once postmortem is posted.
